entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states, utilizing temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to optimize token usage. As an official provider, it supports background memory extraction and vector search, achieving significant task-completion gains in benchmark testing.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that enables persistent long-term memory across agent sessions. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session data, offering compatibility with multiple LLM providers and Python versions 3.10 through 3.14.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain constructs a knowledge graph with typed edges to manage entity relationships and facts with provenance. It supports memory withdrawal and corrections while generating synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, Supermemory features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and knowledge updates while offering connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a learning-based memory system focused on retain, recall, and reflect workflows for AI agents. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and various database backends through SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho serves as the upstream library for stateful agents, providing reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and supports managed hosting, local CLI execution, or Docker-based self-hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a plain markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond performance for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression and importance weighting, with MCP support for integrations like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system employs a seven-layer memory architecture, including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure powered by Docker, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data within the filesystem to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It enables agents to retain lessons and artifacts across iterations through Python, TypeScript, and MCP integrations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a SQLite store and a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). It ensures no messages are lost and includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from multiple coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of historical data. It allows users to search months of past sessions while ensuring safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted memory backend that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to provide portable state across various agents and MCP clients. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving 97.6% average accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership and compatibility with MCP tools. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and embedding search for local-first memory access.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and plugins, utilizing hybrid retrieval including BM25 and vector search to manage agent memory.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a SQLite-backed five-tier hierarchical schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that supports Linux, macOS, and Windows via WSL2.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and save up to 36% in tokens. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching why_retrieved tags to every result and uses a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and includes features for canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid BM25 and semantic search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner to manage state and retrieval. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and stores data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that features automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking via MCP-native integration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for agents using a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, utilizing edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages context and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex through hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration workflow for exporting chats and documents to ensure reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Addressing community issue #6715, this episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate, real event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 37 chain families, including EVM and Solana. It settles payments directly to wallets with 0% fees and verifies transactions locally against the user's own RPC.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes and routes queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers using tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It automates the generation of tool routing notes through model calls to streamline local capability indexing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this provider uses a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox for stable state management. It facilitates pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity across agent interactions.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A, file reads, and semantic search.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage. It utilizes five slash commands for capture and recall, generating evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review to maintain memory hygiene without a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to support software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system generates web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed iframe previews and exports to formats like HTML and PDF. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, for design and prototyping tasks.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library contains 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to provide standardized cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill generates editable .drawio files from prompts, Mermaid text, or images, and can visualize infrastructure from Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud configurations. It also enforces architecture rules and renders visual diffs within CI/CD pipelines.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process. It supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for agents compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library that integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and session traces to facilitate collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 14 metaskills that maintain state in a project's documentation folder. It is packaged as spec-conformant plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection provides 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and transcript extraction for platforms like Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports playlist extraction.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, providing slash commands to manage detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts by generating custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and reports findings alongside identified analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It enables agents to read bundled resources and execute scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents for Hermes Agent. The workflow includes Lite and Full modes for different project scales and features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source code edits back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro acts as a harness for long-running agents using SQLite and Git for local-first session storage and structured memory. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised teams and utilizes Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on an agent's recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills formatted in SKILL.md and supports the agentskills.io standard. It offers localized installation and configuration guides specifically for Portuguese-speaking users.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent interaction with Chainlink services like CCIP, Data Feeds, and VRF. These skills are installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI for standardized discovery and activation.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models into agent workflows via the BFL API. The package includes a specialized router to direct requests to video generation agents and supports polling and webhook handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits within repositories. it supports skill creation from code, documentation, and developer discourse while providing lifecycle management for versioned exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. The platform also integrates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows through a readable .nika.yaml file format and a single Rust binary for local-first execution. It includes a check command to audit task dependencies and estimate costs across different models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from execution failures.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for validating Nextcloud credentials.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye employs a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and FTS5, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to facilitate agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. it supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It implements a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent task state management and multi-story task decomposition.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible README demonstration GIFs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering to compression, ensuring files remain under 8 MB for optimal embedding.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local-first observability dashboard that provides real-time monitoring of Hermes Agent sessions, token costs, and errors across 11 dedicated tabs. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides immediate installation commands and is compatible with clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report drift against official runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all modifications behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible Python runtimes without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: A plugin that allows users to earn or distribute USDC bounties on the Base network without requiring accounts or API keys. It facilitates the entire lifecycle of support bounties, from listing tasks to human-approved settlement.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms via an MCP server featuring 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: A collection of Chinese-language utilities for video-to-text transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It includes a rule-based engine specifically designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes symbols to minimize token consumption and tool calls for coding agents. It features a browser-based UI for visualizing callers and automatically refreshes the index whenever files are modified.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility that monitors token usage across various AI coding agents and tools, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a Terminal User Interface for visualization and allows users to contribute data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes and Cursor while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating detailed analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget tracks real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits for over 35 AI tools by reading agent states directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides granular data breakdowns by model, project, and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any markdown-supporting provider and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows to support autonomous execution on both local hardware and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A customization tool for the Hermes terminal UI that allows users to apply community-created themes, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify ASCII art banners, spinners, and interface colors.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM or GGUF inference.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging using human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce through integrated Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various chat platforms, including Slack, Telegram, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides access to 29 community plugins and free models with zero cost and minimal setup time.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, offline analysis of agent instruction files to flag vague tool descriptions and conflicting output formats. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and integrates into CI workflows via SARIF and baseline reporting.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility moves SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and scheduled active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to help users generate revenue, this tool operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It exposes functionality through dynamic slash commands and requires explicit approval for any external actions or writes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides offline, open-mic functionality with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It supports up to 35 languages via Piper and Kokoro without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: Built with the Tauri 2 framework, this cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It functions as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across multiple platforms including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork app features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access through WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript without a build step, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the use of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools while supporting multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages Hermes, Ekko, Claude Code, and Grok agent runtimes with unified configuration for 10 platforms including WhatsApp and WeChat. It features a visual workflow builder with human approval gates, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a full file browser with Monaco, a PTY terminal, and a memory browser. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside an integrated skills manager and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: This collaborative workspace aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, into a single interface. It supports desktop, Docker, and native mobile clients, and allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management, LaTeX/Markdown rendering, and native process management on Windows and macOS.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active web contexts to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables multi-agent switching with session syncing and provides AI-assisted tab clustering and interactive tab scoping.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and provides mobile management for server files, agent skills, and cron jobs.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It features an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and estimated API costs. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, provides a dedicated interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for local models, TTS, and ComfyUI, supporting both LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and an integrated file browser for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, offering read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
